plan.diagnosis_summary: All four nodes are schema-, row-health- and conservation-clean: `export_shard_code` is a shared benign export metadata column present on every node (mi_norm≈0, no missing canonical columns anywhere), all primary byte/packet identities are exact (median_rel_err 0.0-0.0029, ratio 1.0) and the mild sub-unity sload/dload auxiliary ratios (~0.90/0.876) are identical across all four nodes, confirming common data semantics rather than a per-node unit fault (compare_anchor_quantiles flagged_scale_shifts={}). No cross-node MI shortcut exists (worst outlier ct_dst_sport_ltm robust_z=1.03, gap 0.021, and it is high on three nodes, not one), so node_2's rare-class Non-IID composition and all rare-class concentration are legitimate. Only node_2 shows a genuine localized label-quality fault: with rare classes exempted and ct_dst_sport_ltm excluded, its suspected_noise_rate is 0.110 vs 0.0414/0.0446/0.0438, high_conf_conflict_rate 0.0684 vs ~0.023, mean_self_confidence 0.644 vs ~0.816 and cv_macro_f1 0.545 vs ~0.705, elevated across common classes (DoS 0.338, Fuzzers 0.259, Exploits 0.191).
